title: Crashes as deliberate seeding (gorilla in the cage)
summary: David Grusch tells of Crashes as deliberate seeding (gorilla in the cage), about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: some of these, you know, crashes were and it wasn't really a mission failure, if you will. It was, you know, maybe some seeding.

plain: A witness named David Grusch, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels in 2023, passes on an idea he credits to a man he calls Luis. The idea is that some crashes of non-human craft were not accidents or failed missions at all, but maybe a kind of deliberate "seeding", objects left on purpose for people to find. If true, it would mean whoever made them wanted us to have them.
